mapper.select: SELECT es.*, e.name AS exam_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM paper_question pq JOIN paper p ON p.id = pq.paper_id WHERE p.exam_subject_id = es.id AND pq.deleted = 0) AS question_count, (SELECT p.id FROM paper p WHERE p.exam_subject_id = es.id AND p.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS paper_id FROM exam_subject es LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = es.exam_id WHERE es.exam_id = #{examId} AND es.deleted = 0 ORDER BY es.sort ASC, es.create_time ASC

SELECT es.*, e.name AS exam_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM paper_question pq JOIN paper p ON p.id = pq.paper_id WHERE p.exam_subject_id = es.id AND pq.deleted = 0) AS question_count, (SELECT p.id FROM paper p WHERE p.exam_subject_id = es.id AND p.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS paper_id FROM exam_subject es LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = es.exam_id WHERE es.id = #{id} AND es.deleted = 0
